mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a pleasant temperature of 64 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park and a New Moon phase.

Verona has several updates, including a call for volunteers at the Senior Center and upcoming road construction starting August 18 on Highway M, which will shift traffic patterns and include some lane closures for utility work.

There is plenty to do, with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market, more live music at Paddy Mac's, and the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds all happening tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from August 5, officers located and arrested a 37-year-old man on Whalen Road for a probation violation after he attempted to flee custody.
Today's flavor is the decadent Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM. Tomorrow you can look forward to the Turtle flavor.
